pk.context: 70 mg subcutaneous, single dose, healthy adults

pill.desc: clear to opalescent, colorless to light yellow solution in a prefilled autoinjector

tell: A CGRP receptor antibody for migraine prevention, given as a once-monthly subcutaneous injection.

clues.text: Absolute bioavailability is about 82%. At low concentrations it is cleared mainly by saturable binding to its target, at higher ones by a non-specific proteolytic route; CYP450 enzymes do not metabolize it.
Produced by recombinant DNA technology in Chinese hamster ovary cells, with an approximate molecular weight of 150 kDa. The solution has a pH of 5.2.
Approved under a BLA as 70 mg/mL and 140 mg/mL single-dose prefilled autoinjectors or syringes, given subcutaneously once monthly.
No boxed warning. Contraindicated in serious hypersensitivity, including anaphylaxis and angioedema; injection site reactions and constipation are the most common adverse reactions.
Preventive treatment of migraine in adults.
A monoclonal antibody that binds the calcitonin gene-related peptide receptor and blocks its function.
The generic name begins with E and has eight letters.
